recent_index_changes: (1) Annual reconstitution effective 2025-12-22: ADDED Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (ALNY), Ferrovial SE (FER), Insmed (INSM), Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR), Seagate Technology (STX), Western Digital (WDC); REMOVED Biogen (BIIB), CDW (CDW), GlobalFoundries (GFS), Lululemon (LULU), ON Semiconductor (ON), The Trade Desk (TTD). (3) New Nasdaq-100 methodology effective 2026-05-01 after public consultation: rank-based quarterly reviews in March, June and September (membership can now change at quarterly reviews, not only at the December annual reconstitution); eligibility/ranking now consider listed AND unlisted share classes (full economic size), while index weighting still uses listed shares only (Nasdaq FAQ, July 2026). (4) June 2026 quarterly changes effective 2026-06-22 (first under the new methodology): ADDED Astera Labs (ALAB), CoreWeave (CRWV), Nebius Group (NBIS), Rocket Lab (RKLB), Teradyne (TER); REMOVED Charter Communications (CHTR), Cognizant (CTSH), Insmed (INSM), Verisk Analytics (VRSK), Zscaler (ZS).
